instruction.name: vssrlni.bu.h
instruction.description: Logical right shift the unsigned 16-bit elements in `a` and `b` by `imm`, saturate the result to unsigned 8-bit, write the 8-bit result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
